std_semantics: All21 means and sample SDs reconstruct exactly from archived105 per-AF3-model rows (five models/job). The188-job recovered ensemble instead averages five training-seed means. Neither quantity is calibrated clinical uncertainty.
statistical_limit: delta<ownSD is descriptive, not an equivalence/nonsignificance test. Need paired contrasts, covariance, source/run identity, and predefined equivalence margins; no minimum resolvable delta can be derived from these summaries alone.
